posts.title: Chiba in summer
posts.description: This isn’t new material for someone my age. I literally knew the Cold War logic of assured mutual destruction before I knew that World War II had ever happened. But once that constant existential threat had evaporated, with the collapse of the Soviet Union, a strangely powerful amnesia set in. posts.title: Two hundred and fifty years later
posts.description: I am reliably informed that it has all, this grand experiment of a federated, democratic republic, the only country in the history of anything to have twice elected Donald John Trump to lead it, it’s all boiled down to this: Oregon (in the form of Cascadia) vs. Minnesota (become Megasota). Vote wisely .

posts.title: That’s the way to do it
posts.description: “I knew that I wanted it to be a little wrong. I’d like to make this, like, a little bit funny. Take this a little too far. So I did the tie-dye, which was pink and purple on the pants, and I went a little further with the Home Depot chains. There’s gotta be something wrong about anything that you do, otherwise it’s just plain old cliché.” — Tim Capello
